description: 3D printing corner with two Bambu Lab X1-Carbon printers (Bambu 1 and 2) with AMS units, a Bambu Lab H2D with AMS HT, and Prusa Mini printers in wooden cubbies under the bench.
Arbor press on the workbench with its slotted table plates removed for cleaning, contact cleaner and gloves alongside.
Bench covered with DeWalt and Milwaukee M12 battery chargers, batteries, and a Milwaukee Fuel rotary tool.
Close-up of the hanging belt organizer with button labels for 40T-100T 9mm 5M timing belts sorted by pocket.
Small orange bench grinder fitted with Scotch-Brite deburring wheels on the workbench (hand resting on top for the photo).
Yost 465 bench vise and Klutch benchtop sheet-metal shear on the workbench with a bench grinder in the background.
Utility cart holding a benchtop table saw with an Eastwood manual, funnel, and miscellaneous parts trays.
Blue US General rolling toolbox close-up with labeled drawers for Calipers, xTool MetalFab accessories, and a stale CNC Router label left over from the retired ShopSabre.
Drawer with a keyway broach set in a wooden box, broaches and bushings in tubes, and hand reamers.
Calipers drawer with a dial caliper, two EZ Cal digital calipers, pin vise, and spare batteries.
Red Toolbox drawer 11 (Wrenches) with combination and ratcheting wrenches in 3D-printed sawtooth organizers, handles color-coded by size with tape.
Black Craftsman drawer cabinet (Air Wedges drawer) under a butcher-block bench with the Klutch sheet-metal shear and drill-press vises on top.
Donaldson Torit cyclone dust collector on a blue stand over a drum in the outdoor fenced enclosure.
DeWalt cordless pancake air compressor marked 3847 with coiled yellow air hose under a workbench.
DeWalt DCV581H cordless wet/dry vacuum stored on a shelf under the workbench.
Dragne toolbox drawer 2 with a dial indicator, magnetic base stands, machinist square case, Shars screwless vise, V-block, and a QCTP holder.
Drawer with two Morse-taper drill chucks and arbors, a small bearing puller, a file, and McMaster-Carr hardware bags.
Porter Cable floor-standing drill press next to the Titan press brake by the machine shop doorway.
Blue Durham MFG four-drawer steel cabinet with drawers labeled Non-Radial Bearings and 'It Tried its best :U'.
Durham steel drawer cabinet with drawers labeled Electrical, Kraken, Rivets, and 10-32 Socket.

Durham drawers labeled Magnets/Clecos/Heat Set Inserts/Glue, First Aid, MaxSpline, and Pulleys and Belts.
Durham drawers labeled 10-32 button head/countersunk, Rope/Wire Rope/Straps, MaxPlanetary, and Chain.
Evolution EvoMax aluminum-cutting chop saw mounted on the red US General toolbox with a small belt sander beside it.
Red Toolbox drawer 16 with needle files and jewelers files in printed bins, larger flat/half-round files, and a brass brush.
Dragne toolbox drawer of salvaged gears, pulley hubs, and aluminum/steel round and tube shaft stock.
Grizzly mill/drill (labeled Mill) with milling vise and T-handle wrenches next to the blue PM-1130V lathe on the machine-shop bench.
Grizzly G0555LANV 14-inch vertical bandsaw with the Thunder Laser Nova and blue lathe in the background.
Gweike Cloud M3 Ultra laser cutter with lid raised showing the slat cutting bed, control panel, and carbon-fiber cut sheets leaning against the cabinet.
Red Toolbox drawer 1 (Hammers/Mallets) with claw hammers, dead-blow and rubber mallets, a pry bar, transfer punch set, and ratcheting wrenches.
Red Toolbox drawer 2 (Handsaws) with Stanley FatMax and DeWalt hacksaws/handsaws, spare blades, a carver set, and safety wire twisters.
Full shelving rack of labeled HDX organizer cases, Stack-On small-parts boxes, and yellow pneumatics/connector organizers.
HDX case labeled Elevator Blocks above empty rack slots with a 'You Take 1 Out, Put 2 In' sign.

Stack of HDX cases labeled Wood screws, GoPros, 10-32 Socket Head, and 1/4-20.

HDX cases labeled Swerve fastener box, 8/32, and 32 Countersunk in the slotted case rack.

Green horizontal metal-cutting bandsaw on casters near the red toolbox and a rolling rack of aluminum stock.

Langmuir Systems Titan 25T CNC press brake front view with touchscreen control, tooling dies stored below, and the drill press at right.
Rolling wire drying rack of laser stock (plywood, acrylic, polycarbonate sheets) beside the Thunder Laser.

Lathe Shelf rack with labeled white bins of 3/8 and 1/2 inch hex shaft stock (rounded and sharp) plus round stock and salvage bins.

Drawer of lathe accessories including an MT2 live center, tap holder, boring bars, reamers in tubes, and drill bits.
Machine shop overview from the tool bench with PM lathe, bandsaw, arbor press, belt sander, and battery charging area.

Rolling material cart with labeled polycarbonate sheet slots, aluminum extrusion cubbies, and clamps hung across the top.
Red Toolbox drawer 9 (Measuring) with speed squares, combination squares, levels, steel rules, tape measures, and a laser distance measurer.
Measuring drawer with MG Tool precision micrometers, an iGaging EZ-View DRO Plus, stud/wall detector, and wireless thermometer probes.
Crate of Milwaukee M12 cordless tools including a leaf blower, band saw, drills, and batteries, labeled Spectrum 3847.
Red Toolbox drawer 8 with hollow-shaft nut drivers organized in two 3D-printed sawtooth racks.

DIY powder coating booth with spray gun, respirators, powder paint bottles, and purple-dusted box-fan filter.
Powder coating and storage room with the spray booth, purple-coated filter door, yellow shop vac, and supply shelves.
Quincy QT-5 vertical shop air compressor with air dryer in the outdoor chain-link equipment enclosure.
Red toolbox drawer with a small green drill-press vise, large drill bit, V-block, and layout tools.
Red toolbox top drawer open showing nitrile exam glove boxes, safety glasses, and tap/drill charts, with the chop saw and belt sander on top.

Red Toolbox (US General Pro two-stack) front view with numbered labeled drawers: small screwdrivers, markers, files, screwdrivers, wrenches, hex keys, measuring, nutdrivers, thread taps, sockets, sharp things, pliers, handsaws, and hammers/mallets.
Red US General Pro rolling toolbox (Dragne Toolbox) with numbered drawer labels and a Roughneck lift table beside it.
Rivetnuts drawer with red-handled rivnut installation tools and bags of aluminum and brass rivet nuts sorted in bins.
Red Toolbox drawer 13 with flat-head and Phillips screwdrivers organized in 3D-printed sawtooth racks.
Folding-arm servo electric tapping machine mounted on the workbench near the Evolution chop saw.

StackTech Tape drawer with gaff tape rolls in team colors, T-Rex Brute Force tape, electrical and masking tape, 3M VHB double-sided tape rolls, and self-fusing wrap.
